spans.s:
Sprinkling with water.
E.
आङ्, प्लु to swim, अप् aff.

Sprinkling, wetting.
3 A submerging.
4 A flood, an inundation.
E.
आङ्, प्लुङ् to swim, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Sprinkling with water.
2 Bathing. आङ् before प्लु to swim, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-ती)
An initiated householder, one who has passed through the first order, that of the Brahmacārī, and is admitted into the second.
E.
आङ् before प्लव bathing, व्रतिन् performer of a व्रत, or religious obligation; bathing being part of the prescribed ceremony.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inundated, overflowed.
E.
आङ् before प्लु to bathe, causal form, affix क्त.

ind.
Having wetted or sprinkled.
E.
आङ् before प्लु to swim, ध्यण् aff.

Wetted, sprinkled.
m. (-तः)
An initiated householder: see आप्लवव्रतिन्.
n. (-तं)
Bathing.
E.
आङ्, प्लुङ् to bathe, affix of the participle past.

m. (-ती)
See आप्लवव्रतिन्.
E.
आप्लत bathed, &c. as before.

ind.
Having bathed.
E.
आङ् before प्लु to bathe, ल्यप् aff.
